releaseNotes:
• Zero-Delay Dual-Source OTA Updates: Bypassed 300s Fastly CDN edge caching via 302 redirect tag probing on /releases/latest, instantly discovering new releases with zero API quota consumption.
• Modern Gallery Batch Storage Management: Replaced legacy black-and-white deletion dialogs with a dark glassmorphic GalleryBatchOptionsBottomSheet (#161422) that defaults to freeing device storage while preserving posts and private cover thumbnails in History & Archive, complete with Android 11–16 MediaStore delete consent handling and a safely accordioned Danger Zone.
• Two-Stage Instagram Share Link Normalization: Probes HTTP redirects on opaque /share/r/, /share/p/, and /share/ URLs to discover canonical Reel/Post shortcodes, preventing 404 errors on 2026 app links.
• Hardened Embed Fallback: Multi-endpoint probe (/reel/ and /p/) with strict HTML/Unicode unescaping (&, \u0026, \/, <, >, ") for robust sub-300ms media resolution.
• Eradicated System Alert Dialogs: Replaced blocking modal dialogs in MainActivity with smooth background HUD tracking and a dark glassmorphic DownloadErrorBottomSheet offering 1-tap Retry, Open in Instagram, and Copy Debug Info.
